Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 12095 - 1987 



Indian Standard 

GUIDELINES FOR 
METAL PLATES FOR OFFSET MACHINE 



( Reaffirmed 2003 ) 



1. Scope — Lays down the guidelines for metal plates for offset machines. 

2. Dimensions — The thickness of the plates shall be as given below: 



Nrnniml Size 

Up to and Inciadlng StfQ >< 625 
Above 500 X^SaS: 



Thickness 

(nnm) 

0-3 to 0-4 



3. INAaterial 



0-5 to 0-7 
The metal pjat<^:^all be manufactured from litho^uality aluminium coils and sheets. 



4. Requirernenfs — The surface of the ptate shall be grained to be achieved either by marbles or 
anodized electro- micro grain. Awelt-grained plate shall have a dull uniformly matt surface free from 
sling spot and scratches and shaH have no abrasive particles embedded In it. 

5. Tests 

5.1 Performance Tests 

a) Exposure tests to determine resolution and latitude, 

b) Development tests to determine consistency and latitude, 

0) Deletion tests to determine anti-scum properties of the non-image areas, 

d) Run-length tests to determihe durability on the press, 

e) Ink-water balance tests to determine hydrophillic properties of non-image areas and ink- 
receptive properties of the Image areas, 

f) Press-solvent resistance tests to determine ability of the plate to withstand various types of 
press solvents, and 

g) Edge-cracking tests to determine tensile strength and elasticity of the plate on the press- 
especially web presses. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The details of the performance test, since not available at present, will be Included later on, in 
consultatijpn with the industry. This standard is based on information received from Defence Scientific 
Information Documentation Centre, Research and Development Organization, Ministry of Defence, 
Governm^t of India.
